title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM? Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Runze Liu、Junqi Gao、Jian Zhao、Kaiyan Zhang、Xiu Li、Biqing Qi、Wanli Ouyang、Bowen Zhou（机构：上海人工智能实验室、清华大学、哈尔滨工业大学、北京邮电大学）
paper_type_zh: 计算最优测试时扩展的实证研究
best_for_zh: 比较不同模型规模和任务难度下过程奖励模型引导采样与搜索的读者。
one_line: The study shows that optimal inference-time search depends jointly on generator, verifier, and problem difficulty rather than model size alone.
研究表明最优推理时搜索由生成器、验证器和题目难度共同决定，而非仅由模型规模决定。
why: It makes reward-model compatibility an explicit part of selecting a practical test-time scaling strategy.
inclusion_reason: It analyzes how policy model, verifier compatibility, and problem difficulty determine compute-optimal inference-time search.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Best-of-N sampling, beam search, and diverse verifier tree search can all spend more computation at inference, but their relative value is not fixed. A process reward model may guide one policy model accurately yet mis-score another model's traces because of distribution mismatch. Likewise, a strategy that works on easy arithmetic may waste budget or prune useful alternatives on hard olympiad problems. Choosing a search recipe by model size alone therefore hides the interaction between generator behavior, verifier reliability, and problem difficulty.

The paper asks what a compute-optimal test-time strategy looks like once those interactions are made explicit. It compares policy models, process reward models, difficulty levels, and inference methods under mathematical reasoning budgets. The target decision is a reward-aware choice of search method and hyperparameters for a particular policy and task, rather than an assertion that one universal sampling or tree-search method should receive every extra rollout.

最佳 N 次采样、束搜索和多样验证器树搜索都能在推理时投入更多计算，但它们的相对价值并不固定。一个过程奖励模型可能准确引导某个策略模型，却因分布不匹配而给另一个模型的轨迹错误打分。同样，适合简单算术的策略可能在困难奥赛问题上浪费预算，或过早剪掉有用替代路径。因此，只按模型规模选择搜索配方，会掩盖生成器行为、验证器可靠性与题目难度之间的交互。

论文研究当这些交互被显式纳入后，计算最优的测试时策略应当是什么。它在数学推理预算下比较策略模型、过程奖励模型、难度层级和推理方法。其目标决策是为特定策略与任务选择奖励感知的搜索方法和超参数，而不是宣称某一种通用采样或树搜索方法应获得全部额外 rollout。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core claim is that compute-optimal scaling must be reward-aware. In sampling methods a process reward model decides which completed candidates are selected; in search methods it also changes the trajectory distribution by pruning and expanding intermediate steps. A verifier trained on traces unlike the current policy can therefore alter both the final ranking and the search path itself. The same nominal budget can yield very different results when the policy–verifier pairing changes.

The paper treats best-of-N, beam search, and diverse verifier tree search as alternatives to be selected according to the policy, PRM, and difficulty regime. Its empirical message is not that a small model is intrinsically better than a large one. Rather, a small model coupled with an appropriate verifier and allocation strategy can exploit extra inference work more effectively than a much larger model used with an unsuitable or untuned test-time policy.

核心主张是，计算最优扩展必须具有奖励感知能力。在采样方法中，过程奖励模型决定哪些已完成候选会被选中；在搜索方法中，它还通过剪枝和扩展中间步骤改变轨迹分布。因此，一个在与当前策略不同的轨迹上训练的验证器，既可能改变最终排序，也可能改变搜索路径本身。当策略—验证器配对改变时，同样名义上的预算可以产生非常不同的结果。

论文把最佳 N 次、束搜索和多样验证器树搜索视为应随策略、过程奖励模型和难度区间而选择的替代方案。其经验结论不是小模型天生优于大模型，而是小模型若与合适的验证器和分配策略配合，可能比使用不合适或未调优推理时策略的大模型更有效地利用额外推理工作。

title: Method
方法
html:
The study frames reasoning as trajectories generated by a policy model and assessed by a process reward model. It evaluates three external inference procedures: best-of-N generates N full responses before scoring; beam search repeatedly scores steps and retains a subset; diverse verifier tree search divides search into multiple independently explored subtrees. For each prompt and available budget, compute-optimal scaling selects strategy hyperparameters intended to maximize the probability of the correct answer.

Experiments vary policy models from 0.5B to 72B across two reported families, process reward models from 1.5B to 72B, and MATH-500/AIME24 difficulty conditions. The paper distinguishes on-policy PRMs, trained on the same policy's responses, from offline PRMs trained on other policies; this distinction is used to analyze reward distribution shift. The released repository provides an implementation surface for the compared search procedures and the project page documents the reported evaluation settings.

研究把推理表述为由策略模型生成、再由过程奖励模型评估的轨迹。它评估三种外部推理过程：最佳 N 次先生成 N 条完整响应再打分；束搜索反复给步骤打分并保留一部分；多样验证器树搜索把搜索划分为多个独立探索的子树。对每个提示和可用预算，计算最优扩展选择旨在最大化正确答案概率的策略超参数。

实验改变两个报告模型家族中从五亿到七百二十亿参数的策略模型、从十五亿到七百二十亿参数的过程奖励模型，以及 MATH-500/AIME24 的难度条件。论文区分在同一策略响应上训练的同策略 PRM，与在其他策略上训练的离线 PRM，并用这一差别分析奖励分布漂移。发布的仓库为所比较的搜索过程提供实现接口，项目页记录了报告的评测设置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official paper reports broad MATH-500 and AIME24 comparisons and states that the best strategy depends strongly on policy, PRM, and difficulty. It highlights several cross-scale outcomes under its compute-optimal configurations: a 1B model exceeds a 405B model on MATH-500; a 0.5B model exceeds GPT-4o; a 3B model surpasses a 405B model; and a 7B model beats the cited o1 and DeepSeek-R1 comparisons on the reported tasks. These are empirical configuration results, not claims that parameter count has ceased to matter.

The evidence also identifies reward compatibility as a mechanism. A case study in the paper reports that one PRM favored short responses and produced incorrect answers for a Llama-3.1-8B policy, while a different PRM produced correct answers but used more computation. This makes the comparison useful for test-time allocation: accuracy, reward behavior, candidate length, search method, and compute should be examined together. Replication should use the released code and project settings while rechecking claims against the exact model versions available to the evaluator.

官方论文报告了广泛的 MATH-500 与 AIME24 比较，并指出最佳策略强烈依赖于策略、过程奖励模型和难度。它在自身计算最优配置下强调了若干跨规模结果：十亿模型在 MATH-500 上超过四千零五十亿模型；五亿模型超过 GPT-4o；三十亿模型超过四千零五十亿模型；七十亿模型在所报告任务上超过文中比较的 o1 和 DeepSeek-R1。这些是经验配置结果，并不意味着参数规模不再重要。

证据还把奖励兼容性识别为一种机制。论文的个案研究报告，一个 PRM 偏好短响应，因而为 Llama-3.1-8B 策略产生错误答案；另一个 PRM 则产生正确答案，但消耗更多计算。这使该比较对推理时分配具有价值：准确率、奖励行为、候选长度、搜索方法和计算应被放在一起检查。复现应使用发布的代码和项目设置，同时根据评估者实际可用的模型版本重新核验结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's novelty is to move compute-optimal test-time scaling from a policy-only selection problem to a policy–verifier–difficulty problem. It makes explicit that reward models are not neutral selectors: for search they change the future population of traces, and for sampling they change which trace is allowed to represent the answer. This exposes reward distribution shift as a central systems variable rather than a secondary implementation detail.

It also uses this perspective to reinterpret model-size comparisons. The contribution is not a new universal search algorithm; it is an experimental decision map showing that small policies can win when the reward signal and compute allocation fit the task. That is a useful corrective to raw pass@k or model-size claims, because it ties reported performance to the complete inference configuration that produced it.

论文的新意是把计算最优测试时扩展从只选择策略的问题，转变为策略—验证器—难度问题。它明确指出奖励模型并非中性选择器：对于搜索，它改变未来轨迹群体；对于采样，它改变哪条轨迹被允许代表答案。这使奖励分布漂移成为核心系统变量，而非次要实现细节。

它还用这一视角重新解释模型规模比较。贡献不是提出一种新的通用搜索算法，而是给出一张实验决策图，表明当奖励信号和计算分配适合任务时，小策略模型可以获胜。这纠正了只看 pass@k 或模型规模的主张，因为它把报告的性能与产生该性能的完整推理配置联系起来。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The work is an extensive empirical study, but its compute-optimal choices are evaluated on the stated mathematical benchmarks and PRM/model pools. A PRM's behavior can change under a new prompt format, decoding setting, model revision, or domain, so the reported choice map cannot simply be copied into another serving environment. The headline cross-scale comparisons also depend on the paper's selected budgets and protocols. Verification cost, accelerator throughput, batching, and latency can differ from proxy comparisons, and exact-answer mathematics may not predict behavior on open-ended tasks.
该工作是一项广泛的实证研究，但其计算最优选择是在所述数学基准及过程奖励模型/模型池上评估的。PRM 的行为会随新提示格式、解码设置、模型修订或领域而改变，因此报告的选择图不能直接复制到另一服务环境。醒目的跨规模比较也依赖论文所选的预算和协议。验证成本、加速器吞吐、批处理和延迟可能与代理比较不同，而答案可精确判定的数学也未必能预测开放式任务上的行为。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this study when selecting a test-time policy for a known generator and verifier pair. Build a small validation matrix over problem difficulty, best-of-N/beam/tree-search settings, PRM versions, and budgets; log candidate lengths, PRM scores, selected paths, exact accuracy, tokens, latency, and failure patterns. The goal is to reproduce the decision process, not to copy a winning setting from another model. The public code and project page make it practical to test whether a verifier is aligned with the current policy before giving it control over a large inference budget.
当需要为已知生成器和验证器配对选择推理时策略时，可使用这项研究。应在问题难度、最佳 N 次/束搜索/树搜索设置、PRM 版本和预算上建立小型验证矩阵；记录候选长度、PRM 分数、被选路径、精确准确率、令牌、延迟和失败模式。目标是复现决策过程，而不是照抄另一个模型的获胜设置。公开代码和项目页使测试变得可行：在让验证器控制大量推理预算前，先检查它是否与当前策略对齐。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the reward-aware analysis before focusing on the small-versus-large headline. Inspect how each PRM was trained, whether it is on-policy or offline for the evaluated generator, how search hyperparameters were tuned, and whether budget includes every scoring call. The most useful replication plots accuracy against both tokens and wall-clock cost for every policy–PRM pair, then repeats the sweep by difficulty. A strong result should show not only that a selected configuration improves accuracy, but also that the verifier's score is calibrated enough to justify the pruning or ranking decisions that consumed the budget.
阅读时应先看奖励感知分析，再关注小模型对大模型的标题。需要检查每个 PRM 怎样训练、对于被评估生成器它是同策略还是离线模型、搜索超参数如何调优，以及预算是否包含每次打分调用。最有价值的复现会为每个策略—PRM 配对同时绘制准确率相对于令牌和实际时间的曲线，再按难度重复扫描。强结果不仅应显示选定配置提高准确率，还应表明验证器分数已足够校准，能够合理支持消耗预算的剪枝或排序决定。
